integrity: All polynomial and derivative certificates are reproduced by an included standard-library Python script. Independent mathematical validation has not been conducted; the proof, computations, and source comparisons are open to independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Only the two fundamental character packet of USp(4), moment orders six and eight, normalized Haar measure; generic genus-two Sato-Tate model rather than every Sato-Tate group. Exact joint moments are standard consequences of Weyl integration; the claimed contribution is the sharp global optimization, phase/equality classification, and strict reversal of optimal character weights. Bibliographic priority requires independent review.
title: Sharp sixth–eighth moment crossover for two fundamental characters of \(\mathrm{USp}(4)\)
